sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining returns nil and silently stops when any link in the chain is nil, propagating absence without error
sketches.resonance: Reaching for someone who is gone — the question travels through every connection and returns nothing, without complaint.

sketches.mechanism: A function declared with a return type but containing no return statement — undefined behavior that compilers may silently accept
sketches.resonance: Promising something and giving back nothing; the language lets you get away with it, but the caller is left holding whatever was already in the register — residue mistaken for a gift.

sketches.mechanism: Prolog's closed-world assumption: anything not provable from the knowledge base is considered false
sketches.resonance: If no one ever told the world you were loved, the world concludes you were not — absence of evidence becomes evidence of absence.
sketches.draft:
kind(stranger, stranger).

loved(X) :- kind(X, _), kind(_, X).
